sections.title: Types of homes
sections.content:
Vocabulary for different living spaces:
• detached house — a house not joined to another. They bought a detached house with a large garden.
• penthouse — a luxury flat on the top floor. The penthouse offers stunning views of the city.
• studio flat — a small flat with one main room. Studio flats are popular with young professionals.
• suburbs — residential areas outside the city centre. Many families prefer living in the suburbs.
• renovation — restoring a building to good condition. The renovation of the old theatre took two years.

sections.title: Building and design
sections.content:
Architectural vocabulary:
• facade — the front of a building. The glass facade reflects the sky beautifully.
• spacious — having a lot of room. The apartment is surprisingly spacious for the price.
• infrastructure — basic physical structures of a society. The city needs to invest in its ageing infrastructure.
• landmark — a recognisable building or feature. The tower has become a famous landmark.
• sustainable architecture — eco-friendly building design. Sustainable architecture uses energy-efficient materials.

exercises.question: A house not connected to any other building is:
exercises.explanation: A detached house is not joined to any other building.

exercises.question: Restoring an old building to good condition is:
exercises.explanation: Renovation is the process of repairing and restoring a building.

exercises.question: The front exterior of a building is its:
exercises.hint: What you see from the street.
exercises.explanation: The facade is the principal front of a building facing a street.

exercises.question: A recognisable building used as a point of reference is a:
exercises.explanation: A landmark is a recognisable feature of a landscape or town.

exercises.question: An area with plenty of room and not cramped is:
Roads, bridges, and utilities are part of:
exercises.hint: The basic systems a city needs.
exercises.explanation: Infrastructure is the basic physical systems of a community (roads, power, water).

exercises.question: Residential areas on the edge of a city are:
exercises.hint: Outside the centre but within the city area.
exercises.explanation: Suburbs are residential areas on the outskirts of a city.

exercises.question: A luxury apartment on the top floor is a:
exercises.explanation: A penthouse is a luxurious flat on the top floor of a tall building.
